name: L-Train x 5 Infused Prerolls | L-Runtz
description:
Indulge in the dynamic effects of our L Runtz Atomik Dogwalker blunt 5-pack. Infused externally with live resin and kief, these mini blunt-style pre-rolls are known for providing a noticeable boost of energy and cerebral uplift, followed by a gradual calming effect that leads to a more sedative state. 

Crafted from a premium (all flower) blend, L Runtz offers a versatile experience. Featuring a delightful candy-like flavor with subtle hints of earthiness, making it a perfect balance of uplifting and relaxing sensations.
